name: Plastic Bronchitis

criteria.description: Presence of bronchial casts obstructing airways confirmed by bronchoscopy or expectoration
Recurrent episodes of cough with expectoration of branching bronchial casts
Radiographic or CT evidence of airway obstruction or atelectasis consistent with cast formation
Exclusion of other causes of bronchial obstruction such as infection, neoplasm, or foreign body

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of bronchial casts confirmed by bronchoscopy or expectoration plus recurrent clinical episodes of cough with cast expectoration
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by bronchoscopy and imaging; histopathological analysis of casts may aid in classification.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Airway obstruction due to bronchial casts
searchTerms: breathing difficulty due to airway obstruction

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers during acute episodes
Normal or mildly elevated eosinophil count
Analysis of bronchial casts showing fibrinous or mucinous composition
imaging: Chest X-ray showing segmental or lobar atelectasis
CT scan demonstrating airway obstruction and bronchial casts
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; may be associated with congenital heart disease in some cases
other: Bronchoscopic removal of casts is diagnostic and therapeutic
Association with lymphatic abnormalities in some patients

distinguishingFeatures: Reversible airway obstruction without cast formation
Localized airway obstruction without cast expectoration
Presence of mucus plugs rather than firm bronchial casts
Associated with chronic bronchitis or cystic fibrosis
Less branching and cohesive cast structure

redFlags: Sudden onset airway obstruction with respiratory distress
references: Madsen P, et al. Plastic bronchitis: new insights and classification. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2017.
Brogan TV, et al. Plastic bronchitis in children: a case series and review of the literature. Pediatrics. 2002.
Eberlein MH, et al. Plastic bronchitis: a management challenge. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2008.
